description:
The ZooKeeper service type: znode paths with ZooKeeper's own permissions (read, write, create, delete, admin),
        looked up, browsed and tested with ZooKeeper's own client over an ensemble's connection string, with no, digest or
        Kerberos (SASL) authentication and optional TLS. Packaged as a plugin directory (descriptor, classes and lib/) that
        the release ships in plugins/zookeeper.
